text: Debugging is an essential skill for every programmer. When you identify bugs in your code, the first step is to stay calm and observe the problem carefully. Modern debugging tools, such as breakpoints and step-by-step execution, help you see exactly what your program is doing. A systematic approach works best: reproduce the error, isolate the faulty section, and test one change at a time. Logging is also very useful, because log messages record what happened before the crash. By combining these strategies, you can find and fix problems faster and become a more confident developer.
